ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Limited reported a daily share buyback of 53,607 shares on September 15, 2026, executed on the NSE at an average price of ₹294.64. This action increases the cumulative shares repurchased under their open market buyback program to 1,241,757, a strategic move intended to enhance shareholder value by reducing outstanding shares and signaling management's confidence. The document is a routine compliance filing, and no material red flags are evident.
